name: youtube-transcript-flashdata
description: Retrieve available YouTube transcript text with start and end timestamps. Build cited summaries, searchable notes and transcript exports. Uses the paid FlashData API.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with youtube_transcript enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
